newsitem.title: USA: World Airways in pact with Brazil's VASP.
newsitem.headline: World Airways in pact with Brazil's VASP.

text.p: World Airways Inc on Monday said it has entered into an aircraft leasing agreement with Viacao Aerea Sao Paulo SA, the privately held Brazilian airline known as VASP.
Details of the pact were not disclosed in the company's statement, except that the agreement involved both cargo and passenger aircraft leases.

World leases aircraft to commerical carriers, and typically provides aircraft, crew, maintenance and insurance to its customers, a spokesman said. World's customers provide fuel, marketing services and scheduling.
World recently began flying a DC10-30 freighter for VASP on routes between Latin America and the United States, the company said.
